proof: High-level option A uniquely fixes risk_proxy=1-cos_i, ascending acceptance, fold-safe gating and the descriptive geometry-risk interpretation.

The v3 M2 selection uniquely fixes four curve scopes, two 271 guards, 5-percent rational grid, raw-score degeneracy, separate 1e-12 score/outcome tolerances, admissible exact staircase AURC, scope-local verdicts and reporting/aggregation rules.
Decision-request-v3 supplies complete protocol-error, tie, coverage, fixed-grid piecewise, partition, precedence and stop semantics without consulting result values.
Every prospective protocol/config field below has exactly one source pointer or literal selected by the two stable PF3 receipts; no executor preference remains.
remaining_actions_are_lifecycle_not_deci: activate the node in the external PF3 control plane
perform the declared active-state first-action artifact freeze
compute actual hashes only after those artifacts exist

stop_conditions: PF3 Stage 7.4 node is not verifiably active immediately before the first-action change set
PF3 node identity, contract revision receipt rc_925cc8885871, M2 receipt rc_e47f614a7190 or route revision 66 does not read back exactly
any authoritative input or reference binding path/hash fails readback
unresolved_substantive_decisions is not exactly an empty array
either declared target path already exists; never overwrite, edit or silently version-bump
the two targets cannot be prepared, validated and published as one append-only first-action change set
any Stage 7.3 report/output or residual/alpha/score result value was opened or searched before both targets were frozen
any target field lacks a unique source pointer, requires a default, or conflicts with decision-request-v3
the generated JSON fails parsing, closed-set checks, integer/rational encoding checks or cross-artifact consistency checks
actual post-creation hashes cannot be computed from completed bytes
post_activation_first_action.on_stop: Fail closed before result access or experiment execution. Do not create a partial substitute, overwrite a predecessor, invent a future hash or claim preregistration. Record any later incident only in a new append-only artifact.

opens_only_after: PF3 node activation has completed and read back as active
both exact first-action target artifacts exist and are marked frozen
their actual completed-byte SHA-256 values have been computed and cross-recorded
all first-action validation and stop-condition checks pass
